protocol_version.description: Protocol 1: any 1.x is compatible. A minor version only adds optional fields, which the other side ignores when it does not know them (A22).

config.description: Adapter configuration from the repository settings, such as extension assemblies.

repository_root.description: The repository's own directory, read-only. An adapter reads only its declared external inputs under it, such as installed packages in node_modules, and never sources: those come from the captured workspace.
